integrity.claim_scope: Exact stationary-moment identity and strict model-specific prevalence comparison

scientific_limitations: Applies to the deterministic planar mean-field system and compact interior invariant probability measures, not finite stochastic networks.

Strict comparison to endemic equilibrium requires risk perception zeta>K+2, the physical larger-root equilibrium, and a non-Dirac invariant measure; it is conditional on existence except where the 2022 cycle theorem applies.
The published source proves the existence of oscillations; the quantitative mean–variance law and strictly signed prevalence excess are the claim evaluated here.
A potentially relevant 2023 SIS/social-distancing paper could not be fully inspected, so unrecognized equivalent statements remain possible.
Verification is analytical with supplemental symbolic/numerical checks, not independent expert validation.
title: An exact finite-amplitude prevalence penalty from oscillatory epidemic self-protection
